attributes.hs_scope_note: X-ray, alpha/beta/gamma radiation apparatus incl. radiography and radiotherapy tubes/generators. Contains industrial and security radiography and non-destructive-testing apparatus, which is not medical.
attributes.aggregation_semantics: country-total aggregate of customs declarations; not revenue, not R&D, not firm activity

licence_note: UN Comtrade Usage Agreement §5: 'any copying, automated browsing or downloading, redistribution, publication, or commercial exploitation of any material contained on or otherwise made available to you on United Nations COMTRADE is strictly prohibited without the prior written permission of the United Nations.' (https://comtradeplus.un.org/LicenseAgreement). The keyless preview API is published for programmatic access, so the two instruments are in tension; HORIZON-001 collected a bounded one-off sample for research and treats operational reuse as requiring written permission.
notes: Value is an official reported aggregate. No release/publication date is exposed by the API, so observability_gap cannot be computed.
